GREE 101.d: Reading-based introduction to ancient Greek. Readings include passages from classical and New Testament authors. Explanation and analysis of basic grammar, including comparison with English grammar. Besides translating Greek to English (and vice versa), we will consider the language and literature in their historical context, and practice reading ancient Greek aloud. Effective May 15, 2019, this course does not carry D1 credit.
GREE 101.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.
